description: A-A\*pex is an *anytime* form of A\*pex: it gives a usable front early and makes it better while it runs. Each iteration runs A\*pex with the next, smaller tolerance `ε` from a schedule. Paths that a pruning or a merge dropped, but that can still lead to a Pareto-optimal solution, go to a list, and the next iteration starts from them instead of from the start state. After each iteration the solutions approximate the Pareto front within `1 + ε`; when an iteration drops no such path, they are the exact front and the search stops. The crate has the paper's four variants: reuse, reuse-enh (more pruning by earlier representatives), restart, and hybrid (restart first, then reuse).

papers.authors: Han Zhang, Oren Salzman, Ariel Felner, Carlos Hernández Ulloa, Sven Koenig
papers.title: A-A*pex: Efficient Anytime Approximate Multi-Objective Search

lineage.source: multiobjective-search, src/apex/anytime.rs: "A-A*pex: anytime A*pex that reuses its search effort across tolerance iterations"
